guidance.text: Try one brief digital check that reveals a misconception you want to understand. Offer another way to respond if access gets in the way.

limitations: Each result describes your selected practice for one competence. The original choices are shown as A1 through C2 (1–6); not yet aware is a valid response (0).
This self-reflection is for the participating teacher. It supplies no combined score, rank, performance evaluation, or student outcome claim.
The illustrated reflection prompts are project adaptations. The fixed English items come from the European Commission toolkit and its design report.
report.disclaimer: For supportive professional learning reflection by the teacher receiving their own authorized results. A1–C2 are this framework’s maturity codes, not grades for teacher quality. No EU endorsement, badge or certificate is issued. Existing access and feedback permissions still apply.
